from pathlib import Path
import ast, difflib, hashlib, json, re, subprocess
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/"reports/T0006/review-r3-freeze"
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
old=json.loads((root/"reports/T0006/review-r2-freeze/audit.json").read_text())
last=json.loads((root/"reports/T0006/review-r2/final-audit.json").read_text())
mutable={"README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md","tests/test_proof.py"}
for p,h in old["input_sha256"].items():
    if p not in mutable: assert sha(p)==h, p
for p,h in old["history_sha256"].items(): assert sha(p)==h, p
for p,h in last["artifact_sha256"].items():
    if p not in mutable: assert sha(p)==h, p
product=sha("src/kmesh/logic/proof.py")
test=sha("tests/test_proof.py")
assert product=="008bdd3633a5d2327cd711b7c9de7149df86b588632db659a23bf34207963daa"
assert test=="68fef57a21500f733f9d7a4e1bac671fd71ae5ec2465157dbf71f216d07e3566"
inputs=["src/kmesh/logic/proof.py","tests/test_proof.py","README.md","docs/implementation_status.md",
"docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md","reports/T0006/pi-r3-full/provenance.md",
"reports/T0006/mutation_set_check_r3.py","reports/T0006/record_check.py",
"KMesh_Research_Plan_v0.1.md","KMesh_Paper_Framework_v0.1.md","docs/decisions.md",
"docs/handoffs/T0005-indexed-closure.md","AGENTS.md"]
input_hashes={}
for p in inputs:
    dest=out/"input-snapshot"/p
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    dest.write_bytes(Path(p).read_bytes())
    input_hashes[p]=sha(p)
before=Path("reports/T0006/review-r2-freeze/input-snapshot/tests/test_proof.py").read_text()
after=Path("tests/test_proof.py").read_text()
(out/"tests.diff").write_text("".join(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(True),after.splitlines(True),fromfile="R2/tests/test_proof.py",tofile="R3/tests/test_proof.py")))
def funcs(source):
    result={}
    for item in ast.parse(source).body:
        if isinstance(item,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            result[item.name]=ast.dump(item,include_attributes=False)
        elif isinstance(item,ast.ClassDef):
            for fn in item.body:
                if isinstance(fn,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                    result[item.name+"."+fn.name]=ast.dump(fn,include_attributes=False)
    return result
bf,af=funcs(before),funcs(after)
changed=sorted(k for k in set(bf)|set(af) if bf.get(k)!=af.get(k))
assert changed==sorted(["int_limit_4300","TestLogicalCounterexamples.test_rule_with_too_few_premise_references_is_false","TestHugeIntAtDigitLimit4300.test_positive_huge_premise_reference_verifies_false"]),changed
records=[]
for d in sorted(Path("reports/T0006").glob("pi-r3-*")):
    rec=json.loads((d/"record.json").read_text())
    assert rec["status"]=="finished" and rec["exit_code"]==0,d
    assert rec["before"]["source_sha256"]==rec["after"]["source_sha256"],d
    assert rec["before"]["source_sha256"]["src/kmesh/logic/proof.py"]==product,d
    assert rec["before"]["source_sha256"]["tests/test_proof.py"]==test,d
    for stream in ("stdout","stderr"): assert sha(d/(stream+".txt"))==rec[stream+"_sha256"],d
    records.append({"run":d.name, **{k:rec[k] for k in ("argv","exit_code","elapsed_s","started_at_utc","finished_at_utc")}})
assert len(records)==5
assert "101 passed in 0.22s" in Path("reports/T0006/pi-r3-focused/stdout.txt").read_text()
assert "438 passed in 4.05s" in Path("reports/T0006/pi-r3-full/stdout.txt").read_text()

links=0
prov=Path("reports/T0006/pi-r3-full/provenance.md")
for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",prov.read_text()):
    target=target.split("#",1)[0]

history={}
for p in Path("reports").rglob("*"):
    if p.is_file() and "pytest-tmp" not in p.parts and "__pycache__" not in p.parts and not any(part.startswith("review-r3") for part in p.parts):

assert head=="6dcaae2ef40459e80ed5919e658db84986526211"
